falsification_conditions.condition: BTC closes above $72,000 on any daily candle
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakout above the August 2024 high would invalidate the bottoming pattern thesis and suggest the macro low is already in, not forming

falsification_conditions.condition: Total crypto market cap (excluding BTC/ETH) gains more than 15% in a single week
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Broad altcoin outperformance of this magnitude indicates risk appetite returning aggressively, contradicting the HOLD signal and bottoming accumulation phase

falsification_conditions.condition: US 10-year Treasury yield drops below 3.50% while DXY falls under 100
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Simultaneous collapse in yields and dollar would trigger immediate risk-on rotation into crypto, skipping the expected final capitulation/consolidation phase

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
